verdict.rationale: Twenty's dashboards can track pipeline metrics and revenue trends. They support configurable aggregation, grouping, and filters (twenty-docs-6, twenty-docs-20, twenty-docs-57). That means pipeline value could be summed and grouped, possibly by close date. Nothing documents stage probabilities, weighted pipeline, or a forecasting feature. A founder would have to add custom probability fields and compute weighted values through code workflows or the API (twenty-docs-1, twenty-docs-42). Missing for 10: native stage-probability settings, weighted revenue forecast, close-date-based forecast views, and any hands-on corroboration of forecasting.
